获得减益免疫状态。进入防御姿态，所有被动属性加成提升100%，持续8秒。
提供100%魔法抗性加成，并且免疫纯粹和反弹伤害。持续时间内敌方技能的负面效果不会生效。

被动：强袭光环

Disgraced Regalia

Passive: Fallen

You have died and thus get nothing.

It cannot abide failure.

Swipe for more
runs.beastText:
Beast Shield
42200
ABILITY:No Target
+80 Strength
+1400 Health
+40 Armor
+40% Magic Resistance
+40 Health Regeneration
+40 Attack Speed
+100 Damage
Active: Human Shield
300
60.0

Applies a basic dispel. Enter defensive stance, all passive attribute bonuses are increased by 100%, for 8 seconds.
Grants 100% Magic resistance and immunity to pure and reflected damage. For the duration of the effect, any negative effect from enemy spells has no effect.

Passive: Assault Aura

Grants 10 armor and 50 attack speed to nearby allies. Reduces -10 armor of nearby enemies.

Radius: 900

The ultimate defensive equipment fused with the power of the beast rune, allowing the user to become an indestructible fortress.

Swipe for more
runs.sacredText:
Legendary Hexad
42000

+160 All Attributes
+100 Attack Speed
+40% Movement Speed
+46% Status Resistance
+80% Health Restoration

+50% Spell Damage
+100 Magic Damage Attack
+40% Mana Cost/Mana Loss Reduction
+50% Cast Speed Bonus

To gather all three legendary swords in their perfected form and forge them into one, the power within is beyond measure.
